rationale: S-0022-01 proposes a Nav1.1 proximal-AIS knockout channel-swap on the t0022 testbed. Brainstorm session 9 explicitly de-emphasised the t0022 channel-testbed lineage in favour of the from-scratch minimal DSGC substrate (t0052 / t0053 / t0054 / t0057). The Nav1.1 knockout question may still be valuable for a future axon-channel-variation track, but is no longer on the critical path. Reprioritising from high to medium.
